collision_bounds.proof: For limited slides, each geom center is affine in finger q; norm is convex, hence corner maximum bounds every legal q. MuJoCo geom_rbound encloses that geometry. Triangle inequality is invariant under arbitrary hand rotation.
collision_bounds.limitation: A positive separation concerns this gripper, not all other robot links or arbitrary unprescribed excursions between endpoints.

conservative_workspace_bound.proof: Triangle inequality over fixed-length descendant body offsets and site offset; arbitrary hinge rotations preserve lengths. No joint-range or collision restriction is needed, so the enclosing sphere is conservative for every physically possible joint configuration.

limits: Frozen checkpoint, one task and five known scenes. Privileged interventions are not pure WAM successes. A positive ideal finger separation concerns the prescribed endpoint path, not all possible robot motions.

quasistatic_cases.evidence: Exogenous replay of the first 300 frozen targets; privileged time dilation, not a live-image WAM policy or the 20Hz task benchmark.
